canSolveWith.description: Standard LeetCode topic tags applicable to solve this question.

userUsed.description: The specific algorithmic topics or techniques the user actually implemented in their code.

userTime.description: Big-O time complexity of the user's submitted code, e.g. 'O(n)', 'O(n^2)'.

userSpace.description: Big-O auxiliary space complexity of the user's submitted code, e.g. 'O(1)', 'O(n)'.

optimalTime.description: The optimal Big-O time complexity for this problem provided in the Question Analysis capsule.

optimalSpace.description: The optimal Big-O auxiliary space complexity for this problem provided in the Question Analysis capsule.

isTimeOptimal.description: true if the user's time complexity matches or is asymptotically equal to the optimal time complexity, else false.

isSpaceOptimal.description: true if the user's space complexity matches or is asymptotically equal to the optimal space complexity, else false.

guidance.description: null if BOTH isTimeOptimal and isSpaceOptimal are true. Otherwise, concise pedagogical guidance explaining how to optimize the algorithm and reach optimal complexity.

strengths.description: 1 to 3 concise bullet points identifying verified strengths in the code (e.g. edge case handling, zero allocations).

improvements.description: 1 to 3 concise, actionable suggestions for cleaner variable naming, modularity, or idiom improvements.
